profile_summary: Java Developer with 2 years of experience building web-based, enterprise-grade applications on Java 17, Spring Boot, and Spring Security. At Percipere (UK), designed and implemented a REST ↔ SOAP integration layer using Apache Camel to bridge legacy SOAP services with modern REST clients inside a SAP-integrated enterprise platform deployed across multiple countries, alongside 37+ REST APIs and 4+ production go-lives with zero critical post-live defects. Comfortable across the full development life cycle design documentation, coding, unit/integration testing, debugging, and deployment using Maven-based builds with AWS and CI/CD. Strong grasp of JVM internals (JIT, GC), OOP/SOLID, and microservice design.

experience.title: Java Developer
bullets: Designed and built a REST-to-SOAP and SOAP-to-REST integration layer using Apache Camel, enabling a SAP-integrated enterprise platform to expose modern REST endpoints on top of legacy SOAP services deployed across multiple client environments internationally.

Developed 37+ REST APIs across 5 backend modules on Spring Boot, securing endpoints with Spring Security (role/action-based access control) and keeping client and server fully decoupled for independent release cadences.
Delivered 4+ production go-lives end-to-end covering design, coding, unit/integration testing, debugging, and UAT sign-off, with zero critical post-live defects.
Built a DB-driven dynamic configuration system that rolls out new business rules and routes via a single database entry, with zero code changes and no re-deployment across environments.
Diagnosed and resolved a race condition in an Apache Camel route under peak load by fixing the underlying shared mutable state. Zero production incidents since.
Built Maven-based CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps) and CloudFormation infrastructure-as-code, cutting environment provisioning from 4-6 hrs to 15-20 min and deployments 40
